title: Google Assistant support: Device not responding to hotword
description: Discover how to troubleshoot when your Google Assistant device isn't responding to “Hey Google” or “Ok Google”.  Visit support.google.com/assistant for more troubleshooting tips.

asr.full_text: Hey Google. Okay Google. Hey Google? Having trouble getting your Google Assistant to respond? Try these three simple steps. First, make sure the mic or speaker is not covered or blocked. Also, check that your Google Assistant device is plugged in,. Or if you're using a portable speaker, that the battery is fully charged. Charged. Second, try muting then unmuting your device. Third, check the audio recording by opening the Google Home app, tapping the menu button,. Then My Activity. Tap Play to hear the latest voice command. Hey Google, what's the weather today? If you hear static, perform a factory reset by pressing and holding the mute or reset. Button for 15 seconds. Hey Google, can you hear me? Loud and clear. For more information, click here for the Google Assistant Help Center article.
